headline: Thunderstorms are slowing Newark and delaying flights into New York and Boston.

items.text: Newark (EWR) is the soft spot: 78% of departures so far today left within 30 minutes of schedule (302 departed), the lowest of the seven hubs reporting. Thunderstorms, heavy rain and wind gusting to 32 knots are slowing arrivals and departures there, and 21 of its 391 departures are confirmed canceled.

The FAA has a ground stop for flights into Boston until 9:30 PM ET because of thunderstorms, and rates the chance of an extension as high. Ground delay programs for flights into New York JFK and New York LaGuardia, both because of thunderstorms and until 11:59 PM ET, average 74 minutes and 92 minutes, up to 180 and 210 minutes, while no program is in effect at a United hub.
Rain at Washington Dulles (IAD) can cause minor delays, and 10 of its 248 departures are confirmed canceled; the other hubs are running normally.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to New York JFK or LaGuardia, or to Boston, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
